title: From Scripts to Reliable Systems: Five Engineering Habits I Now Use
summary: Five practical habits that make small data and automation workflows easier to trust: explicit input contracts, early validation, durable state, visible recovery paths, and review for consequential actions.
impact: Shows how I think about reliability before scale: prevent ambiguous inputs, make failure visible, preserve recoverable state, and leave the next person a system they can understand.

title: AI in Education: From Sentiment to Evidence
summary: A methodology note on why survey compatibility, data provenance, confounders, and cautious causal language matter more than simply collecting more AI-in-education data.
impact: Demonstrates evidence discipline: separate attitudes from outcomes, compare only compatible sources, document limitations, and avoid conclusions the data cannot support.

title: Building Reproducible MLB Analytics from Structured Data
summary: A compact case note on turning structured sports data into validated, queryable, reproducible analytics with Python and SQLite.
impact: Shows the full analytical path from input validation and normalized storage to derived metrics and repeatable proof outputs.
